subject: eng
title: Grammar 6A Ch 2: Connectives (so that / so / because) & To-infinitives

questions.q: Peter practises the piano every day ___ he can pass the piano exam.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.5：表示「為了達到某目的」（後接 can / will 子句）用連接詞 so that。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Peter practises the piano every day ___ he can pass the piano exam.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 6A Ch 2: Connectives (so that / so / because) & To-infinitives

questions.q: The prince wanted to save the princess, ___ he fought the wicked dragon.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.5–6：前半句是原因，後半句是結果（戰鬥），中間用連接詞 so（因此）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: The prince wanted to save the princess, ___ he fought the wicked dragon.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 6A Ch 2: Connectives (so that / so / because) & To-infinitives

questions.q: Candy didn't go to the party ___ she had a bad cold.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.5：後半句說明沒去派對的原因（患了重感冒），用連接詞 because。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Candy didn't go to the party ___ she had a bad cold.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 6A Ch 2: Connectives (so that / so / because) & To-infinitives

questions.q: Remember ___ the windows before you leave the classroom.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.7：remember + to-infinitive（Remember to close）表示「記得要做某事」。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Remember ___ the windows before you leave the classroom.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 6A Ch 2: Connectives (so that / so / because) & To-infinitives

questions.q: My little brother is learning ___ a bicycle in the park.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.7–8：動詞 learn 後面要接帶 to 的不定式（learn to ride）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: My little brother is learning ___ a bicycle in the park.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 6A Ch 2: Connectives (so that / so / because) & To-infinitives

questions.q: Complete with 'to' + verb (Grammar 6A p.7): Oh no! I forgot ___ (bring) my English workbook today.
questions.explain: forget 後接 to-infinitive：forgot to bring（忘記帶）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Complete with 'to' + verb (Grammar 6A p.7): Oh no! I forgot ___ (bring) my English workbook today.

questions.q: We often use modal verbs like 'can', 'will', 'could' or 'would' in the clause after 'so that' to show purpose.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.5，so that 引導的目的狀語從句常配合 can / could / will / would 使用。
questions.subject: eng
